title: Individual blk.1 and blk.2 Q8_0 up-skip correctness gates with CPU-compatible arithmetic

candidate.name: Individual full-layer up skip for blk.1 and blk.2
candidate.why_this_step: The current name filter is substring-only, so exact blk.0-2 combined coverage is not expressible yet. Individual layer checks expand correctness coverage while keeping failures attributable.
candidate.expected_ttft_impact: Not evaluated in this correctness-only run.

correctness_gate.check: Run llama-results --check twice, once per filter, with GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_CPU_COMPAT=1 and --top1-fail-on-mismatch.
correctness_gate.pass_condition_per_filter: llama-results exits 0, same_top1 == n_tokens, first_mismatch_pos == -1, max_abs == 0, mean_abs == 0.
correctness_gate.failure_rule: If either layer fails, do not add multi-filter/all-up support; inspect the first failing layer/record.

promotion_rule: This correctness run cannot be promoted as SOTA. It only decides whether to proceed to combined/all-up verification.
